# Avish Taxi Tangalle

> Private taxi, airport transfer and tour driver service based in Tangalle on the south coast of Sri Lanka, run by local English-speaking driver Avishka. Bookings 24/7 on WhatsApp +94 76 562 7939. Prices are per vehicle in Sri Lankan Rupees (LKR). Prices can be negotiated and may change from day to day, but we will always give you an affordable rate.

- Website: https://avishtaxi.github.io/
- WhatsApp / phone: +94 76 562 7939 (https://wa.me/94765627939)
- Based in: Tangalle, Southern Province, Sri Lanka (serves Tangalle, Hiriketiya, Dikwella, Rekawa, Mirissa, Weligama, Galle, Yala, Udawalawe, Ella and island-wide)
- Hours: 24 hours, 7 days a week
- Languages: English, Sinhala
- Vehicles: car (1–3 passengers), SUV (1–4), van or shuttle (4–8)
- Services: airport transfers (Colombo CMB and Mattala HRI), point-to-point taxi, day tours (Yala safari, Udawalawe elephants, Galle Fort, Mirissa whale watching, beaches near Tangalle, Mulkirigala and Hummanaya), multi-day round tours, hotel and villa pick-ups, hourly and full-day car hire with driver

## Taxi prices from Tangalle (per vehicle, LKR)

| Route | Car (1–3) | Van / shuttle (4–8) | Driving time |
|---|---|---|---|
| Colombo Airport (CMB) → Tangalle | 25,000 | 33,000 | about 3 to 3½ hours |
| Mattala Airport (HRI) → Tangalle | 15,000 | 18,000 | about 1 hour |
| Tangalle → Galle Fort | 16,000 | 19,000 | about 1½ hours |
| Tangalle → Mirissa | 9,000 | 13,000 | about 1 hour |
| Tangalle → Weligama | 10,000 | 14,000 | about 1¼ hours |
| Tangalle → Yala / Tissamaharama | 20,000 | 23,000 | about 1¾ hours |
| Tangalle → Udawalawe | 15,000 | 18,000 | about 1¾ hours |
| Tangalle → Ella | 23,000 | 27,000 | about 3 hours |

## How to book

Send pickup point, destination, date, time and number of passengers on WhatsApp +94 76 562 7939. Every booking button on the website opens a short form that writes this message automatically. A confirmed price is usually sent within minutes.
